summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh GitHub release matching the installer's platform, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with a rotating string-array decoder and heavy identifier mangling; its contents are not human-readable at review time. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers and key-object indirection (e.g. `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)`) to conceal the download-extract-execute flow. The dropped runtime and the executed payload are unrelated to the package's stated Slack/Teams channel-transformer purpose. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time to execute a bundled opaque payload bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
